title: Review of c22's metabolic-crawler no-fission probe: replicates on fresh seeds 1-2; at doubled rim uptake the crawler grows 2.27 -> 6.74/6.77 and saturates as one body with one front, 0 splits by t=60
summary: labkit runs of the rim-uptake crawler (SYN_RIM=1, ksyn=0.2, kdeg=0.1, rn=0.25, L=6, N=300) on fresh seeds 1 and 2 to t=60. Area 2.27 -> 4.15 (t=10) -> 5.85 (t=30) -> 6.42 (t=45) -> 6.74 and 6.77 (t=60), slowing as reported; one component and one track the whole run, 0 splits, 0 nucleations; the cell crawls 11 body lengths with a single front (sheet). The dynamics are deterministic after the planted start, so the seeds differ only in heading. Supported.

observations.finding: rerun/seed1, seed2: area 2.27 -> 6.74/6.77 at t=60 (6.42 at t=45), 1 component throughout, splits 0; rerun/seed2/sheet.png one crescent with one front

seeds_run.result: pass: saturating growth to 6.74, no fission
pass: saturating growth to 6.77, no fission

verdicts.limitation: Deterministic after a planted start, so two seeds are nearly one experiment; one feeding level; t=60 only, area still creeping up (+0.3 over the last 15 t).
